history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that information about surviving dependants who are children be reflected separately in the data on retirees to ensure that age-gap calculations are correct. The Board also recommended that the Administration identify and update the correct status of the 643 cases where participants have not been identified either as surviving dependants or retirees.
history.administration_response: The cases where retirees were survived by dependent child(ren) rather than by spouse(s) were tracked manually for the 2023 year-end full actuarial valuation. Only 13 records were identified and confirmed, some of which represent children with disabilities. In the case of the latter, the age limit of 21 years, after which the benefit should stop, does not apply. The overall impact on the calculation of the After-Service Health Insurance liability is insignificant. The Administration has received written confirmation on this from the independent actuary and made it available to the Board. The Administration hereby requests closure of this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that the overall impact of the cases on the calculation of the After- Service Health Insurance liability is insignificant, and the Administration received a written confirmation on this from the independent actuary, the Board considers this recommendation to be implemented.
